instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.
Use this skill when the user wants to report task results to Feishu/Lark after completion, with a preflight check that the reporting channel is available.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of lark-work-report-skill.
- Enables reporting task results to Feishu/Lark groups with a preflight check to ensure the reporting channel is available.
- Automatically finds, confirms, or creates the "Codex工作群" work group as the reporting channel, with user confirmation at each decision point.
- Sends concise task summary reports to the confirmed group after task completion.
- Ensures user identity and group identity are explicitly verified before sending reports.
- Does not poll Feishu/Lark for follow-up instructions or manage task intake outside the CLI conversation.
